blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) released the approved fare adjustments for buses and other public transportations, which will take effect on Monday, Sept. 28. In an advisory posted on Facebook, the LTFRB said the fare adjustment for ordinary Metro and City buses is rated at P15 for the first kilometer, with an additional P2.49 for the succeeding kilometers. Meanwhile, fare rates for air conditioned Metro and City buses will start at P18 for the first kilometer, and P2.98 in the kilometers that will follow.
